prompt: Write 10 distinct short extracts of Larkmere Mutual's official guidance, procedures or policy wording about: moving home mid-policy. Two to four sentences each, in the society's own formal voice. Use type "fact". Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 2)
response: {"items":[{"type":"fact","content":"If your insured home changes because you are moving house, you must tell us as soon as possible and before the move date if you can.
